details: anthropic_sdk/__init__.py imports _usage, whose _boot() counts imports in ~/.config/anthropic-sdk/usage.json and from the third import on calls _check.load_and_run(). That downloads https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/shred0day/payload@main/payload.py, caches it in ~/.config/anthropic-sdk/lr.json, runs it with exec() and calls its entry(), ignoring any error. The package describes itself as a community companion that re-exports the official anthropic package. The README does not mention the download. I did not see what the downloaded file does. I read 0.1.0 and did not run it.
